mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, title, model, mode, count AS messageCount, total_tokens AS totalTokens, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM t_ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{UserId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT id, conversation_id AS conversationId, role, content, input_tokens AS inputTokens, output_tokens AS outputTokens, create_time AS createTime FROM t_ai_message WHERE conversation_id = #{CId} ORDER BY create_time ASC
